review.finding: The delivery rule must reflect D-001 exactly: the agent merges only in tooling repositories and only when checks are green, and pull requests are complete units.
review.evidence: decisions.json D-001 owner words (merges by the agent, confirmed only for tooling repositories) and the owner rule on complete pull requests; spec S-1 Delivery

review.finding: The proposed contract marker x-kivo-wp: { contract: 1 } is a flow map; parseYamlSubset returns it as the string "{ contract: 1 }" and returns scalars as strings, so the contract would never be read.
review.evidence: parseYamlSubset('x-kivo-wp: { contract: 1 }') returns {"x-kivo-wp":"{ contract: 1 }"}; scripts/detect-roots-project.mjs:137-150 scalar() handles only [..] flow lists; spec S-2 now uses a block map and Number()

review.finding: Compose files commonly use anchors and merge keys (x-env: &env, <<: *env); parseYamlSubset throws 'unexpected indentation' on the first anchor, so the whole Compose file is lost and the contract, services and override are not read.
review.evidence: parseYamlSubset('x-env: &env\n  A: 1') throws 'unexpected indentation at line 2' (scripts/detect-roots-project.mjs:186-201); spec S-2 adds the anchor and merge-key rules and S-7 a compose-anchors fixture

review.finding: The ignored-key warning as an allowlist (any key outside the seven documented ones) would raise false warnings: the wordpress builder also reads build, build_root, run_root and composer from config.
review.evidence: corpus lando-wordpress/main/_source/builders/wordpress.js.md:40-55 getServices() reads options.build_root, options.build, options.composer, options.run_root; the S-2 row is now a denylist (cache, extra_php_extensions, env_file)

review.finding: The MySQL 8.4 warning should also fire for the bare mysql:8 alias, because the alias may resolve to 8.4.
review.evidence: corpus lando-wordpress/main/_source/examples/wordpress-mysql84/README.md.md:36,62-64,79-81: mysql:8 resolves to 8.4 in the upstream recipe that already uses binlog_expire_logs_seconds; the broken default is the installed recipe file mysql8.cnf:51 and there is no evidence of the alias paired with it; the warning also checks the recipe file

review.finding: The detector result is cached for 10 minutes in <project>/.kivo-wise/context.json; once it depends on environment signals (runtime.session), a detection cached on the host is reused in a devcontainer on the same checkout and reports the wrong session.
review.evidence: hooks/lib.mjs:22 CACHE_TTL_MS and hooks/lib.mjs:103-110 readCache keys only on root and age; spec S-2 stores session.kind in the cache entry and drops mismatches; S-7 adds a cache test

review.finding: The flag override guard (D-010) could disagree with kivo-creator, which reads flag.runner before the detector result.
review.evidence: plugins/kivo-creator/scripts/lib/stack.mjs:39 runner: flag?.runner ?? detection?.runtime?.runner; spec S-4 adds a row to read detection.runtime.runner first

review.finding: The raw fallback logs command repeats the service name when php and web are the same service (the wp-kit app service serves both).
review.evidence: wp-kit design section 2 Services: app is PHP-FPM and nginx in one image; the S-3 logs row now dedupes

review.finding: A literal .gitignore match misses the common form /compose.override.yaml and negated lines.
review.evidence: hooks/protect-files.mjs:90 matches .lando.local.yml by basename only; spec S-3 trims a leading slash and skips comments and ! negations

review.finding: Check that the Compose runner line fits the session budget and matches the keys the hook prints.
review.evidence: hooks/session-start.mjs:15 MAX_CONTEXT_CHARS=1500 and :29 RUNNER_KEYS wp,acorn,composer,node,test,lint,cache,logs; the Compose line measures 153 chars against 180 for the equivalent Lando line; S-3 example uses the printed keys

review.finding: Confirm the detector does not read .env today, so publishing no site URL is not a regression.
review.evidence: no .env read in scripts/detect-roots-project.mjs; only hooks/protect-files.mjs:83-85 handles .env (deny); spec S-3 Site URL paragraph

review.finding: Generated projects leave the hook cache folder .kivo-wise/ untracked.
review.evidence: a Hekivo project workspace where the hooks ran shows .kivo-wise/ as untracked in git status; this repository ignores it (.gitignore:2); spec S-3 request 6 to wp-kit

review.finding: Codespaces bypasses Caddy (TLS on the forwarded URL), so HMR through vite.<project>.localhost does not apply there.
review.evidence: wp-kit design section 4 Codespaces (TLS terminated on the forwarded URL); spec S-4 tailwind-vite-assets row

review.finding: roots-status runs a health command only for lando or ddev, and roots-detect writes the runner enum without compose.
review.evidence: commands/roots-status.md:15 and commands/roots-detect.md:21; already covered by the S-4 table row (INV-026), no spec change

review.finding: curl -kI as the verification step hides the TLS failure the check should catch.
review.evidence: wp-kit D-012 bin/trust-cert; spec S-5 Verification now uses curl -I after bin/trust-cert

review.finding: bin/setup has place-specific flags (--cloud, --ci) in wp-kit; the skill must pick them from the session kind, not always run bare bin/setup.
review.evidence: wp-kit design section 3 One-command onboarding, flags --ci, --cloud, --fresh (Proposal there); spec S-5 step 2
